hero.h1: I Build the Trust Layer for AI.
hero.sub: Building ALPAR AI, DecasHub & Agent-OS — the sovereign infrastructure for AI accountability.

ecosystem.title: The Ecosystem
ecosystem.alparai_desc: World’s first independent AI incident registry. EU AI Act Article 73 compliant. Zero-knowledge logging. Trust Badges for AI providers.
ecosystem.decashub_desc: A venture studio for autonomous physical systems. AI-coordinated water, carbon, logistics, and energy assets.
ecosystem.agetos_desc: Open-source autonomous agent runtime. Manages multi-agent swarms, memory, identity, and execution.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.p1: AI will be the most consequential technology in human history.
manifesto.p2: Most companies are racing to build it. Few are building the infrastructure to hold it accountable.
manifesto.p3: I believe trust is not a feature — it is the foundation. An AI system that cannot be audited, contested, or governed is not a tool. It is a liability.
manifesto.p4: ALPAR AI exists because accountability cannot wait for regulation. It must be built into the architecture — from day one. This is my life’s work.
